dedupe_keys.name: dataset of multi objective optimization results for a new latent energy storage approach in buildings based on several phase change materials with different melting temperatures

description: Facundo Bre publishes results from multi-objective optimisation of latent energy storage in a small office building. Several phase-change materials with different melting temperatures are evaluated in eight climate-representative locations within WMO Region VI, using the ASHRAE 169-2020 classification. The description identifies EnergyPlus baseline models, Pareto fronts and models of the best designs for annual total-load reduction. One ZIP contains this study bundle, freely available through Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. The data support comparison of building heating and cooling designs. A limitation is that the native metadata does not enumerate all locations, optimisation variables, time steps or numerical Pareto solutions. The separate climate-representative-location deposit supplies related methodological context. Model execution and the reported savings were not checked, and the archive was not opened.
